title: Space Base Mars — Opening Titles
look: warm retro-sitcom film grade, gently saturated 1990s broadcast television look, soft key lighting, subtle film grain, cheerful

dana.description: Commander Dana Vosh, a weary woman in her late 50s with a neat silver bob and tired eyes, wearing a slightly-too-tight navy colony command uniform with a mission patch, warm sitcom studio lighting, photorealistic character portrait

krill.description: Doctor Favius Krill, chief science officer in his 40s with wild frizzy grey hair and safety goggles pushed up on his forehead, wearing a scorched white lab coat, manic delighted grin, photorealistic character portrait

bex.description: Bex Okafor, a station engineer in her 30s with braided hair and a deadpan expression, wearing a grease-streaked orange jumpsuit and a heavy tool belt with a roll of duct tape, arms crossed, photorealistic character portrait

hollis.description: Hollis Pemberton, a gangly geologist with thick glasses and an earnest delighted smile, wearing a knitted cardigan under a hi-vis vest, gently cradling a red Mars rock, photorealistic character portrait

zane.description: Zane Cruz, a vain comms and content officer in his 20s with styled hair and a bright influencer smile, wearing a sleek EVA suit with a small ring-light rig clipped to the chest, photorealistic character portrait

arlo.description: ARLO, an obsolete boxy retro-futurist maintenance android with a single flickering amber eye and a faded corporate logo on its chest panel, slightly hunched passive-aggressive posture, photorealistic character

shots.prompt: @krill grins as a beaker erupts in green smoke in a cramped science lab, @bex stands beside him deadpan holding a roll of duct tape, @zane leans into frame filming the chaos on a glowing phone rig
shots.motion: the beaker overflows with green foam, Krill throws his arms up laughing, Bex calmly steps back unimpressed, Zane pushes in closer for the shot

shots.prompt: @dana slumps at a cluttered command desk rubbing her temples over a stack of unread reports, while @arlo the android solemnly waters a completely dead brown potted plant beside her
shots.motion: Dana drops her forehead onto the desk in despair, Arlo tips the watering can over the dead plant and its amber eye flickers

shots.prompt: @hollis proudly holds up a glowing red Mars rock in an office lined with labelled rock samples, @dana forces a polite smile beside him, @krill eyes the rock hungrily
shots.motion: Hollis presents the rock beaming, Dana claps politely without enthusiasm, Krill reaches for the rock and Hollis twists away to protect it

shots.prompt: three astronauts on the red Martian surface under a dusty pink sky, @zane strikes a selfie pose in his sleek EVA suit, @bex facepalms in her orange suit, @hollis crouches over a rock ignoring them both
shots.motion: Zane poses and gives a thumbs up then stumbles backward over a rock, Bex shakes her head slowly, Hollis keeps happily inspecting the ground

shots.prompt: all six crew of Space Base Mars assembled together in a heroic team pose in the main control room full of glowing monitors: @dana stands center with arms crossed, @krill grins holding a smoking beaker, @bex leans on a console, @hollis cradles his red rock, @zane takes a group selfie, @arlo the android stands stiffly at the edge, warm sitcom lighting, wide ensemble group shot
shots.motion: the crew hold their heroic pose as the camera slowly pushes in, Zane's selfie flash pops, Arlo gives a stiff little wave
